title: Measured signals and versioned quality evaluation

subtasks.description: Compute speech/silence/talk ratio/overlap/rate from intervals with precise metric definitions and denominators.
Define supported intent/topic/entity/outcome taxonomy and schema with evidence and unknown values.
Implement structured extraction validation, confidence/abstention policy and critical-entity review routing.
Create versioned scorecards, weights, applicability, thresholds and pass/fail/NA/insufficient-evidence semantics.
Add deterministic keyword/script checks and contextual criteria using qualified targeted model evaluation.
Persist criterion evidence, calculation version and score denominator; prohibit inferred NPS or unsupported churn probabilities.
Compare scores with adjudicated human QA and add regressions for negation, missing speakers, low ASR confidence and contradictory evidence.
